messages:
sophia: quick sync — I drafted a bring-up gating checklist for the new xz-40b candidate. want to align on pass/fail thresholds before we schedule quant experiments.

ajay: thanks — can you paste the checklist here? also we should call out which eval suites are mandatory vs optional.

sophia: pasted below. TL;DR: perf, llm-eval w/ core prompts, safety smoke, and a 24h stability run on dedicated small pool. optional: domain-specific reranker tests.

sophia: Gating checklist (proposed) — please react with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown: per item
1) Basic generation parity: mean ROUGE/chrF delta <= 2% vs baseline on L2-clean evals.
2) Latency SLO: p95 <= 1.8x baseline on 2k-token window in hosted config.
3) Cost: quantized FP16/INT8 run yields >= 1.6x token/sec-per-GPU vs baseline baseline-gpu.
4) Quality regressions: no prompt group with >5 point drop in calibrated accept rate (manual labels).
5) Safety: automated safety filters false positive rate <= baseline + 0.5% and no new hard failures.
6) Stability: 24h smoke on a dedicated small pool with no OOMs and <0.1% error rate.
7) Ops readiness: runtime kernels validated for KV cache behavior; can start/stop without losing sessions.
8) Rollout plan: canary on 5% traffic, auto-fallback to baseline on error spike >2x.

marco: nit: item 3 — "cost" should reference specific quant configs. propose we require both PTQ/QLoRA-ish INT8 and a 4-bit option where supported. also add exact perf bench harness: `benchgen --seq 2048 --batch 8`

elin: for item 4 (manual labels) we need smaller cardinality: 250 prompts per prompt-group to be actionable. larger groups can be sampled.

qa-jen: adding QA checklist:
- regression harness: run `eval/regressions/compare.sh baseline xz-40b --suites core,dialogue,math`
- human eval: 200 pairwise comparisons on critical prompts (we'll use the judged pool)
- flakiness: run 3 seeds for generation randomness check

ajay: thanks — can engineering guarantee kernel parity for prefix/KV cache? last time we saw misaligned attention kernels that changed tokenization timing and p95.

sophia: engineering (cc @devops-bot) — can you confirm the plan for kernel selection and a kernel test we can add to the onboarding checklist?

devops-bot: planned maintenance window created: infra/bench-queue @ 1848220000. Auto-bench job template: `xz-onboard-v1` will run perf + stability. Logs and artifacts pushed to s3://redwood-onboard/xz-40b/.

marco: ok — plan for kernel test: small-sanity harness that runs `--seq 512` and `--kv-warmup 128` and asserts identical token alignments vs baseline inference trace for 1000 traces. need sign-off from runtime.

elin: also add a prompt-sensitivity sweep for hallucination spikes: we saw subtle hallucination mode changes with 4-bit quantization on other models. add `sweep/hallucination/lowshot.yaml` to required suites.

qa-jen: question on rollout: do we require A/B baseline traffic for at least 48h or is phased canary enough?

sophia: phased canary OK if canary has automated acceptance checks (quality metrics, latency, errors). require 48h if canary is <10% traffic.

ajay: timeline ask: we want initial quant experiments in this sprint (ends in 6 days). can ops provision a 4-GPU small pool for 48h?

devops-bot: request queued. estimated earliest allocation: 1848207200 (6h). ETA subject to capacity.

marco: I'll own the quantization matrix: FP16 baseline, PTQ-INT8, QAT-4bit (if train infra ok). will post matrix and target knobs by EOD.

elin: I'll scope human eval and sampling plan — will use stratified sampling across dialog, code, and long-context prompts.

qa-jen: I'll start creating the regression harness PR, including the `compare.sh` script and the 250-sample grouped evals. expecting a review cycle ~24h.

sophia: final ask: please add any hard blockers here by EOD. otherwise I'll open a tracked onboarding ticket and schedule the bench window.

marco: one blocker: need a quick check that tokenizer config (byte-pair merges) matches loader — mismatch led to tokenization drift in last candidate. can someone from runtime confirm?

ajay: runtime confirmed in DM that tokenization config is identical in model package, but we need automated token-diff check in CI. adding to checklist.

sophia: awesome. thanks everyone. I'll turn this into issue /project card and ping here when created. :rocket:

devops-bot: issue created: RB-1457 — "Onboard xz-40b: gating + quant experiments". Assignees: marco, qa-jen, elin. Artifacts: s3://redwood-onboard/xz-40b/

marco: :raised_hands:

elin: ✅

qa-jen: starting the harness now, will comment PR link when ready.

sophia: closing the sync thread — will follow up in RB-1457.
